summary: each session browses differently and reaches new accounts
changes: each session starts on a random keyword and a random post, pages through a few posts, then scrolls further down the results.
posts earlier sessions already showed are skipped when newer ones are in reach, so running the same keywords again gets to accounts you haven't followed yet.
posts with nothing left to do, like ones already liked from accounts you follow, usually get a quick look instead of a full watch.
replace the files in your original extension folder, reload the extension and reopen warm-up.
